hotspots.title: Trump Midterm Rally Frenzy
hotspots.blurb: President Trump and Vice President JD Vance crisscross the Midwest and Alaska delivering high‑energy rallies ahead of the midterms, while local GOP candidates ride the wave. The flurry of events is framed as a decisive push to energize the base and swing tight races.
hotspots.affect: The relentless rally schedule is portrayed as a battle for the soul of the party, generating outrage against opponents and triumph for the MAGA crowd.

hotspots.title: Super Intelligence Force AI Task Force
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration unveiled a new “Super Intelligence Force” led by Jay Clayton to steer U.S. AI policy, positioning itself against calls for a slowdown and claiming to keep America ahead in the tech race.
hotspots.affect: The launch is framed as a bold, defiant move against perceived bureaucratic inertia, stirring alarm among tech critics and pride among supporters.

hotspots.title: Trump‑Funded Ad Controversy
hotspots.blurb: After backlash over taxpayer‑funded advertisements, Trump announced his super PAC will cover the cost, while critics decry the ads as illegal and propaganda. The debate intensifies with NFL airings and Vance’s defense of the ads.
hotspots.affect: The story pits government misuse against free‑speech claims, generating outrage, accusations of corruption, and defensive triumphalism.

hotspots.title: Immigration Crackdown Mobilizes Voters
hotspots.blurb: Trump’s aggressive immigration enforcement is becoming a wedge issue, especially in swing states like Maine and California, where officials warn of election interference and local protests erupt.
hotspots.affect: The policy is portrayed as an existential threat to communities, igniting fear, moral panic, and partisan rallying.

hotspots.title: Denaturalization Drive Sparks Legal Fury
hotspots.blurb: The administration launched its largest ever denaturalization effort, targeting 40 naturalized citizens for crimes ranging from child abuse to tax evasion, prompting fierce criticism from civil‑rights groups and legal experts.
hotspots.affect: The initiative is framed as an unprecedented assault on citizenship rights, provoking outrage and accusations of authoritarian overreach.
